*** FTSE CAVEAT — FOURTH MORNING RUNNING ***
.FTSE returned Wednesday's close (10,458.50, stamped 2026-10-07) on all three reads at 07:54, 08:02 and
08:07 BST. Same on 5, 6 and 7 October. BUT last night's evening read at 17:51 returned the live 16:35
close correctly. The lag is therefore confined to the first half-hour or so after the London open, not a
general fault in the feed. A second provider is only needed for morning editions.
